title: Prepare the Data
brief: You have the 14 base MFG objects. Cut them down to something an agent can answer from.
Build these in your own schema:
vw_aum_reporting  — month-end AUM per account in USD, discretionary split explicit,
held-away separated, one row per account per reporting date.
vw_net_flows      — settled flows only, in USD, with exchanges kept out of sales
dim_client_safe   — client attributes with every direct identifier removed.
Then: keep your schema to 8 objects or fewer, write column comments on at least 10
columns, and make sure none of the four PII columns is reachable from what you expose.
The numbers are checked against the reference, so a view that runs but sums a daily
snapshot will fail. That is the point of the lab.

checks.name: Your schema holds 8 objects or fewer
sql: SELECT count(*) <= 8 AS ok, concat(count(*), ' objects') AS detail
FROM {{YOU_INFO}}.tables WHERE table_schema = {{YOU_SCHEMA}}
checks.hint: Genie reads every object as context. Drop what nobody asks about.

checks.name: vw_aum_reporting exists and is one row per account per reporting date
sql: SELECT count(*) = 0 AS ok, concat(count(*), ' duplicated account/date pairs') AS detail
FROM (SELECT account_id, as_of_date FROM {{YOU}}vw_aum_reporting
GROUP BY account_id, as_of_date HAVING count(*) > 1)
checks.hint: Grain first. If a join fans out, every total downstream is wrong.

checks.name: vw_aum_reporting carries only month-end reporting dates
sql: SELECT count(*) = 0 AS ok, concat(count(*), ' non-reporting dates present') AS detail
FROM {{YOU}}vw_aum_reporting v
LEFT JOIN {{CORE}}dim_date d ON d.date_key = v.as_of_date AND d.is_reporting_date
WHERE d.date_key IS NULL
checks.hint: A daily snapshot summed across dates multiplies the book. Filter to reporting dates.

checks.name: AUM ties to the reference at the latest reporting date
sql: WITH d AS (SELECT max(date_key) rd FROM {{CORE}}dim_date WHERE is_reporting_date),
yours AS (SELECT cast(sum(managed_value_usd) AS DECIMAL(20,0)) v
FROM {{YOU}}vw_aum_reporting WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT rd FROM d)),
ref AS (SELECT cast(sum(managed_value_usd) AS DECIMAL(20,0)) v
FROM {{CORE}}vw_aum_reporting WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT rd FROM d))
SELECT yours.v = ref.v AS ok, concat('yours ', yours.v, ' vs reference ', ref.v) AS detail
FROM yours, ref
checks.hint: Convert with dim_fx_rate at the snapshot date, and exclude held-away from managed value.

checks.name: Held-away assets are separated from managed value
sql: SELECT count(*) > 0 AS ok, 'held_away column present' AS detail
FROM {{YOU_INFO}}.columns
WHERE table_schema = {{YOU_SCHEMA}} AND table_name = 'vw_aum_reporting'
AND column_name LIKE '%held_away%'
checks.hint: Held-away is reported on, not managed. It belongs in AUA, in its own column.

checks.name: vw_net_flows excludes unsettled and cancelled instructions
sql: SELECT count(*) = 0 AS ok, concat(count(*), ' unsettled rows leaked in') AS detail
FROM {{YOU}}vw_net_flows n
JOIN {{CORE}}fct_flows f ON f.flow_id = n.flow_id
WHERE f.status <> 'SETTLED'
checks.hint: Pending may not happen and cancelled did not. Filter to SETTLED.

checks.name: Net flows tie to the reference, with exchanges netting out
sql: WITH yours AS (SELECT cast(sum(amount_usd * external_sign) AS DECIMAL(20,0)) v FROM {{YOU}}vw_net_flows),
ref AS (SELECT cast(sum(amount_usd * external_sign) AS DECIMAL(20,0)) v FROM {{CORE}}vw_net_flows)
SELECT yours.v = ref.v AS ok, concat('yours ', yours.v, ' vs reference ', ref.v) AS detail
FROM yours, ref
checks.hint: EXCHANGE_IN and EXCHANGE_OUT move money inside Meridian. They are neither a sale nor a redemption.

checks.name: No PII is reachable from anything you expose
sql: SELECT count(*) = 0 AS ok, concat(count(*), ' identifier columns exposed: ',
coalesce(array_join(collect_list(column_name), ', '), '')) AS detail
FROM {{YOU_INFO}}.columns
WHERE table_schema = {{YOU_SCHEMA}}
AND lower(column_name) IN ('ssn_last4', 'email', 'dob', 'annual_income')
checks.hint: dim_client carries the identifiers. Expose a safe view instead of the table.

checks.name: At least 10 columns are documented
sql: SELECT count(*) >= 10 AS ok, concat(count(*), ' documented columns') AS detail
FROM {{YOU_INFO}}.columns
WHERE table_schema = {{YOU_SCHEMA}}
AND comment IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(comment)) > 20
checks.hint: Genie reads column comments as context. 'the market value' teaches it nothing.

checks.name: The 380-column custodian feed is not exposed
sql: SELECT count(*) = 0 AS ok, 'holdings feed kept out' AS detail
FROM {{YOU_INFO}}.tables
WHERE table_schema = {{YOU_SCHEMA}} AND table_name LIKE '%holdings_raw%'
checks.hint: Every column is context Genie must read before it can write SQL.
